text: The Bidder shall hold a valid NMSB 7310 certificate.
The Bidder shall hold electrical contracting rights (class S2 or higher).
The Bidder shall hold a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja ("Verified Supplier") certificate at the time the tender is submitted.
The Bidder's turnover for the most recently closed financial year shall be at least EUR 5,000,000.
The Bidder shall employ at least 20 HVAC (LVI) professionals in its own workforce.
The Bidder shall have at least one reference project with a value of at least EUR 300,000.
Describe the scope, frequency, and reporting format of scheduled HVAC maintenance visits proposed for the contract period.
Describe how the tenderer will receive, verify, and maintain the property asset register and associated technical documentation handed over at contract start.
List the trade qualifications and site-access clearances personnel will hold when working in occupied health and social care premises.
Describe how statutory lift inspection and maintenance obligations will be met and documented.
Submit an occupational safety plan covering work in and around active patient-care areas.
Confirm compatibility with the Buyer's existing building automation protocols (BACnet/Modbus) and describe any integration work required.
State typical lead times for common spare parts and the approach to parts for discontinued equipment.
Describe internal quality control and testing procedures for completed maintenance and repair work.
Describe the escalation procedure used when a reported fault is not resolved within the agreed response time.
Describe measures proposed during the contract period to improve the energy efficiency of the maintained systems.
Describe the approach to scheduled testing and maintenance of fire protection systems.
Describe how continuity of service will be maintained if key maintenance personnel leave or are reassigned.
Propose service level targets for response and resolution times by fault category.
Describe the programme for statutory periodic inspection of electrical installations across the properties.
Describe the commissioning and testing procedure applied following equipment replacement or major repair.
Describe the approach to F-gas-regulated maintenance of refrigeration and cooling equipment on site.
State any limitation of liability proposed, with reference to the relevant clause of standard terms if applicable.
Propose a discount structure applicable as call-off volumes under the framework increase over the contract period.
All prices shall be quoted in euro.
Set out the proposed pricing structure, distinguishing fixed-price visits, unit-priced parts/materials, and time-based call-out charging.
State proposed invoicing frequency and confirm ability to invoice electronically in a compatible format.
Confirm acceptance of the payment terms set out in this invitation and its annexes.
Describe how subcontractor costs will be made transparent to the Buyer on request, where subcontractors are used.
The payment term is 30 days net from the date of the invoice.
Reference form (Liite 2) to be completed and enclosed, listing the reference project(s) relied upon to satisfy Section 3.
Certificate of tax payment to be enclosed.
Description of the quality system to be enclosed.
CVs of key personnel proposed for the contract to be enclosed.
Prices shall be quoted in EUR per square metre per year, not in EUR per month.
State the delivery channel and number of copies in which the tender is to be submitted, per the procurement unit's instructions.
All monetary figures shall be rounded to two decimal places.
The minimum font size used in the tender document shall be 11 pt.
Note the time zone and exact closing time stated for the submission deadline in Section 9.
Describe how subcontracted trades will be selected, supervised, and quality-assured, including which portions of the work, if any, will be subcontracted.
Provide a method statement describing how installation and replacement works will be carried out in occupied buildings with minimal disruption.
Submit a preventive maintenance plan covering all system categories, with proposed inspection intervals for each.
State proposed response time for fault situations by severity category and describe the on-call arrangement outside normal working hours.
State the warranty period offered on equipment and materials installed under the framework agreement.
Describe the training to be provided to the Buyer's own property staff on the operation of maintained systems, including building automation controls.
Describe the proposed approach to periodic inspection of the condition of the building envelope (roofing, facades, building fabric).
If the Bidder cannot demonstrate round-the-clock on-call cover in Finland, the tender will be rejected regardless of price (absolute requirement).
Maintenance visits shall be logged in the reporting system on the day they are carried out.
Materials used in maintenance and repair work shall meet the technical standards applicable to health and social care premises.
Personnel working in patient-care areas shall observe the Buyer's infection-control and access instructions at all times.
Any deviation from the scope described in this annex shall be agreed with the Buyer's technical contact in writing before work commences.
Describe the bonus-malus arrangement proposed for over- and under-performance against agreed service level targets, including calculation and application.
State the index proposed for annual price adjustment during the framework period and the reference month for calculation.
Prices submitted shall remain valid for 120 days from the closing date; tenders may not reserve the right to revise prices during this period except per the indexation clause.
Under the commercial terms of this annex, the payment term is set at 14 days net.
Invoices shall reference the relevant call-off order number and the property to which the work relates; disputed lines shall not delay payment of the undisputed portion.
All framework pricing, including any indexed adjustments, shall be expressed and administered in euro.
Trade register extract (kaupparekisteriote), issued no earlier than three months before the closing date.
Confidentiality undertaking, signed by an authorised representative of the tenderer.
Certificate of pension insurance payments, covering the tenderer's own personnel.
The Contractor shall ensure that personnel assigned to the contract meet the qualification requirements described in the invitation and remain suitably qualified throughout the contract period.
The Contractor shall maintain liability insurance appropriate to the scope of work for the duration of the agreement.
